list: The official 55 trophies, as Exophase and PSNProfiles listed them on 2026-11-18: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden on PlayStation until earned.
note: Every guide below is our own advice, written from the official description, and not yet checked in the game — GTA 6 released on 2026-11-19 and no complete verified walkthrough exists yet. Where a place or a step is not pinned down by the official description, the guide says so plainly instead of inventing one.

beebom.label: Beebom — which 28 trophies are hidden, and the final mission worded as Chapter 5

cryptogames.label: CryptoGames — the stranger-mission chains have windows tied to story progress, citing TechWiser

egamers.label: EGamers.io — Positive Mental Attitude reported as possibly missable, citing GTABase and PowerPyx

exophase.label: Official list on Exophase — name, description, grade

psnprofiles.label: PSNProfiles — grades and the PSN count where one is tracked

trophies.guide: The platinum lands the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Follow the roadmap in this guide from the story through the side strands and the collectible clean-up, and it pops last.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing — the first mission of the game, so this is the first trophy most players earn. Nothing to prepare and nothing extra to do: just play the opening through to its end. Because it is a named story mission, earn it while you are in it; whether missions can be replayed afterwards is not confirmed yet.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Play the story in order and the trophy pops when the chapter's final mission ends. No side content is needed for it — just finish the chapter.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Play the story in order and the trophy pops when the chapter's final mission ends. No side content is needed for it — just finish the chapter.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Play the story in order and the trophy pops when the chapter's final mission ends. No side content is needed for it — just finish the chapter.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Play the story in order and the trophy pops when the chapter's final mission ends. No side content is needed for it — just finish the chapter.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission — the story's last mission, after Chapter 4. Finish it and the gold pops. Some outlets word this as Chapter 5; the official description says 'the final mission', and that is what this guide follows.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. It is a named story mission, so it comes up as you play the story — finish the mission and the trophy is yours. Treat it as a story moment: play it when it arrives, since whether missions can be replayed afterwards is not confirmed yet.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. A named story mission — finish it during the story. Expect a big set-piece heist; the official description gives no extra objective, so completing the mission is the whole requirement.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. A named story mission — finish it when it comes up in the story. The official description gives no extra objective beyond completing the mission.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. A named story mission — finish it when it comes up in the story. The official description gives no extra objective beyond completing the mission.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown, at Vice City International Airport. A named story mission — finish it when it comes up in the story. The official description gives no extra objective beyond completing the mission.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. A named story mission — finish it when it comes up in the story. The official description gives no extra objective beyond completing the mission.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion — the gold that sits behind everything else. In GTA games 100% means the story, all stranger strands, the collectibles and the activities; use the in-game stats page to see what is left. This is the last gold most players earn, after the other 53 trophies. The exact 100% checklist is not spelled out in the official description, so check the in-game completion tracker as you go.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are jumps, airtime, near-misses and the like — they add up across normal driving, so this comes naturally over a long playthrough. To push it faster, use ramps and long jumps and keep a stunt-heavy driving style; PSN tracks the count to 250.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once — PSN counts 9 activity types. Sample everything the open world offers (races, fishing, arcade games, bowling, the shooting range and the rest) at least once each. You do not need to win or master any of them; one try of each type is enough.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges — PSN tracks 42 of them. Work through the range's challenges weapon by weapon and replay any that fall short of gold. The official description does not name the range locations, so follow the in-game map markers once you are in Leonida.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 locations. Find the drone-race spots, learn each course, and win at all 14. Losing a race costs nothing but time; retry until you win.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Race across Leonida — street, off-road, whatever the game offers — and win 20 distinct events. Replaying the same race does not count twice; you need 20 different ones.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal and the fishing challenge, then out-fish him. The official description does not say where Cal is or which challenge counts, so look for fishing spots and the challenge prompt in the world.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game through to its end. Find an arcade machine, pick a game and play it to completion. Any arcade game counts; pick the one you enjoy.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's strand is a stranger chain: take his missions as they appear and finish the last one. Reports say stranger chains have windows tied to story progress, so do Andy's missions when they appear rather than leaving them for after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's strand is a stranger chain: take his missions as they appear and finish the last one. Reports say stranger chains have windows tied to story progress, so do Kenton's missions when they appear rather than leaving them for after the story.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's strand is a stranger chain: take his missions as they appear and finish the last one. Reports say stranger chains have windows tied to story progress, so do Billy's missions when they appear rather than leaving them for after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Stranger missions are the side-mission chains marked in the world; finish 8 full strands. Start them early — several strands are tied to story progress, so do not leave them all for the post-game.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's strand is a stranger chain: take his missions as they appear and finish the last one. Reports say stranger chains have windows tied to story progress, so do Randy's missions when they appear rather than leaving them for after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand is a stranger chain: take his missions as they appear and finish the last one. Reports say stranger chains have windows tied to story progress, so do Tyrone's missions when they appear rather than leaving them for after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots. Find the meditation spots and meditate at each one. This is the one trophy other guides flag as possibly missable, so do not put it off: meditate at a spot whenever you pass one, and clear them as you find them rather than saving them for the end.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunt targets one specific animal — which animal is not confirmed in the official description, so follow Bret's strand and the in-game prompts. It is a hidden trophy, so the details stay vague on purpose.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Find the collectible cards scattered around Leonida and complete 3 full sets. Cards are a long grind — grab them whenever you are nearby rather than hunting them all at the end.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK It is the in-world photo-and-share feature — use it at 100 different locations. It adds up fast if you use it whenever you reach a new place.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's side objectives; finish 50 of them across any categories. Check the challenges menu to see which are closest to done and finish those first.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the cops together. Use fast cars, back roads and the map's edges to break line of sight; the trophy pops once you are clear.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Rob a shop with your partner, then two more in a row while the wanted level stays on. Plan a route between three nearby shops and keep moving — standing still is what gets you caught.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or enter 100 different vehicles and they count as discovered. Variety is the point: try everything from scooters to trucks as you find them.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate Combat Focus (the slow-motion aiming mode) in a firefight and drop 5 enemies before it ends. Pick a fight with plenty of cover and clustered enemies — a mission shootout is the easiest place.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, Vice City International Airport. The plain reading is to take a plane and leave without a schedule — steal one and take off. The official description is deliberately vague; try the obvious airport stunt and it should pop.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Rhinos are the tanks — the description is a joke, not an instruction. The honest read is to do something notable with a Rhino tank: steal one, survive in one, or take one on. The exact trigger is not pinned down in the official description, so get in a Rhino, cause chaos, and watch for the pop.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Plan the robbery quietly: go in masked, avoid the cameras and the guards' sightlines, get out clean. If you are spotted, the trophy is gone for that attempt — leave and try again.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Rob five bank vaults and get away each time. Space them out, plan the getaway before you go in, and do not rush the fifth.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, hit it, and escape with the take. Trucks run set routes — watch for one, strike, and vanish before the response arrives.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — 52 areas. Visit every named area on the map. Drive, fly and walk the state; the map fills in as you go, and the trophy pops when the last area is discovered.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs. Find each gang's illegal operation and rob one of each. You need all nine gangs, so keep a list of which you have done.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail somewhere with a view, and enjoy it. This is a quiet-moment trophy — it pops when you take the drink in the right spot.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through a vehicle showroom's frontage and out the other side. Pick a showroom with a big glass front and enough road to build speed.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go bowling at that alley and finish a game. Any score counts — just follow through.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description is deliberately cryptic. The honest read is to do something with your partner that the game counts as a public 'personal best' moment. The exact trigger is not pinned down in the official description — follow the story and side content with your partner and it will come.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PSN tracks a count to 500 for this one — choices across the game. Keep playing and making choices; it pops once the count is reached. Which choices count is not spelled out in the official description.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail something, then succeed on the second try. The exact trigger is not pinned down in the official description — the natural read is a retry: fail a challenge or mission attempt and then pass it on the next try.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Witness something strange in Leonida. The game's weird, hidden moments — odd encounters and unexplained events — are the likely trigger. Keep your eyes open while exploring; the exact event is not pinned down in the official description.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. From a moving vehicle, hit someone with a melee attack. Low speed, a clear target, and a melee swing as you pass — it is a stunt more than a fight.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Launder marked bills through your contacts until $250,000 is clean. It adds up over the game; keep laundering whenever you have marked bills rather than letting them pile up.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Spend $100,000 in shops — clothes, weapons, vehicles, whatever. Big purchases help: save this for when you are buying cars or other expensive gear.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 of them. Buy every garage property in the game. They cost money, so this one waits until you are rich; check the property listings as your funds grow.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find 10 vehicles and register each one in the app. Any ten vehicles count — register the ones you drive most.
trophies.name: On the Spot
